sentences.text: Petition under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 ('Cr.P.C.') has been preferred on behalf of the petitioner for setting aside order dated 27.12.2023 granting regular bail to respondent No. 2 in FIR No. 270/2023 under Sections 420/467/468/471/120B IPC registered at P.S. : Chhawla.
Learned APP for the State appears on advance notice and accepts notice.
Status report / reply be filed before the next date of hearing with an advance copy to learned counsel for the petitioner.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 25/01/2024 at 17:02:36
Respondent No. 2 be served by all permissible modes including through I.O. on necessary steps being taken by the petitioner, returnable on 14.03.2024.

List on 14.03.2024 ANOOP KUMAR MENDIRATTA, J.
JANUARY 16, 2024/R
